sentences.quote: UnitedHealth Group's medical care ratio improved to 88.4% from 89.9% in the third quarter of 2025.
sentences.text: Margin recovery is underway at the core insurance business: UnitedHealthcare's medical care ratio improved to 88.4% in the third quarter of 2026 from 89.9%, on cost management, benefit design changes and pricing discipline, lifting its operating margin to 3.3% from 2.1%.
Management raised full-year 2026 guidance to adjusted earnings of at least $20.50 per share, up from a prior $19.50 to $20.00 range.
Optum Health's operating margin rose to 3.2% from 0.2% a year earlier, and management targets a 6% to 8% margin by 2028.

Optum Insight revenue increased 3% to $5.5 billion, while operating earnings rose to $1.28 billion from $920 million.
The business continues developing AI-enabled healthcare solutions designed to streamline clinical documentation
sentences.text: Optum Insight is selling AI-enabled documentation and payment-accuracy tools, with revenue up 3% to $5.5 billion.

thesis_pillars.text: Margin recovery is underway at the core insurance business: UnitedHealthcare's medical care ratio improved to 88.4% in the third quarter of 2026 from 89.9%, on cost management, benefit design changes and pricing discipline, lifting its operating margin to 3.3% from 2.1%. Optum Insight is selling AI-enabled documentation and payment-accuracy tools, with revenue up 3% to $5.5 billion. UnitedHealth Group reiterates a long-term earnings growth target of 13% to 16%.
